Accessible Delivery
Accessibility is part of the product experience. Visual consistency cannot substitute for functional testing.

Ratio checks are one part of accessibility, not a conformance claim.
Contrast and meaning
The colour guidance follows WCAG 2.2 contrast
minimums for text and required non-text graphics.
The logo exception is not a reason to make
navigation faint. Use labels with status colours and
underline inline links when colour is ambiguous.
Focus, input and motion
Use a visible focus ring with clear separation from
the control. Aim for 44 px touch targets as a product
guideline. Respect prefers-reduced-motion; optional
transitions should not carry information. Do not
animate the logo on every screen.
Validate the final context
Test keyboard order, zoom, text wrapping, validation
and screen-reader names. Give a linked logo an
accessible name such as "FNLLA home"; hide
duplicate decorative marks. Review the actual
viewport, not only this fixed-format PDF.
